Samir: Observing an alloc surge on kv-shard-canary-3 starting ~03:12 UTC; OOMs triggered at 03:14. Graph -> https://metrics.internal/redwood/allocs?shard=3 . Synthetic load causes steady mem climb, rolling canary paused. Need quick mitigations + owners. pprof top looks heavy on slab residency and async prefetch refs. dump -> s3://redwood-infer/dev/dumps/3182468100-heap.tar.gz
Maya: Oncall here. Thanks for the heads up. I'll pause the canary and reduce concurrency. Samir, can you drop the heap dump path in thread? :thumbsup:
Samir: Dump link above. Also ran `pprof --alloc_space -base=baseline.pb.gz /proc/1234` and exported a `top` list. Initial notes: fragmentation + sticky KV refs from prefetch routines (alloc_map.go:112, kv_reserve.go:78).
Alex: I can take ownership of deep profiling. Immediate plan: 1) run slab-scan to map residency buckets 2) enable soft eviction on shard 3) capture per-thread alloc stacks with ms sampling. ETA: initial findings in 48h. Assigning to Alex.
Maya: I enabled eviction soft-limit on shard and lowered canary concurrency to 50%. Rolling canary remains paused.
Jen: Ops will schedule a rolling instance restart tonight to flush transient residency and add a temporary guard `--kv-max-residency=100MB` to the canary config. Creating ticket now.
Ops-Bot: Ticket created: INF-1129 "alloc-surge temporary mitigations" https://jira.internal/INF-1129 Assigned to Jen, target: 2026-03-25.
deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed -> rev 772 restored. Health checks passing. Monitoring for 30m. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Long-term ideas: heap sampling in prod, KV refcount instrumentation, safe prefetch cancellation, and slab freelist coalescing to reduce fragmentation. Propose a playbook workshop next Tue 10:00 to draft concrete steps.
Samir: Action summary (brief): - Alex: profiling + slab-scan report (48h) - Jen/Ops: restart + kv-max-residency guard (today) - Maya: monitor gating + canary policy (ongoing) - Samir: collect alloc traces + write leak hypothesis (24h). Will post a follow-up summary in #postmortems after Alex's report. Tagging @Maya @Jen @Alex
Maya: Added INF-1129 and the profiling task to my sprint board. I'll own monitoring and alerts until we have a permanent fix. :spiral_calendar:
Samir: Note: this pattern looks similar to last month's alloc surge (see INF-0987 summary https://internal/reports/INF-0987). Possible regression from async prefetch PR#801 — Alex, can you grep the delta?
Alex: On it. Quick grep shows PR#801 changed reserve semantics in alloc_map.go; will include commit diff and call stacks in the profiler report.
Jen: Ops will run nightly slab-scan for the next 3 nights and send a daily digest to this thread. Adding a recurring on-call memory-drift check.
Samir: Ok — next sync in 48 hours (two days) at 11:00 to review Alex's findings and decide remediation timeline. If anything regresses before then, re-open this thread. :eyes:
